units.summary: Adds an unexported function type that builds a restricted BlockReader view of the head for a [mint, maxt] range. It is only a type declaration, and compactHeadViewLocked and its callers use it. The type itself adds no runtime behavior, so the behavior to review is in those callers.
units.headline: New headViewFactory type for per-chunk-range head views
units.reason: A type declaration with a doc comment has no behavior of its own. Its callers are reviewed in their own units.

units.summary: Adds an unexported function type for the callback that evicts written series from the head. It takes the head's MaxTime and an append-ID watermark. The type adds no behavior itself. Its doc comment states the eviction contract that the stale and selected-series callers must follow.
units.headline: New headSeriesEvictor callback type with eviction contract
units.reason: A type declaration and comment only. The eviction logic lives in truncateStaleSeries and truncateSelectedSeries, which are separate units.
